summary: Lewis Hamilton and Ferrari's Charles Leclerc trade fast-lap bragging rights into Budapest, with Hamilton's commanding Friday pace signaling Mercedes' intent to reclaim momentum at a circuit that favors precision over raw speed. Fernando Alonso's major Aston Martin upgrade arrives at the Hungaroring as a potential career inflection point, offering the two-time champion a glimpse of whether his team can genuinely challenge for podiums. A victory here would shift the championship narrative dramatically—Hamilton closing a critical gap to the leaders, or Leclerc cementing Ferrari's resurgence with a second consecutive win.
